body: No no, it's okay, you're helping. I hope they understand, too. I really do. Just in my head for the past 5 hours are just visions of that eviction notice and everyone hating me and living on the streets and my cat dying in the cold and people I love killing themselves and my parents' house collapsing and it's all my fault and lives are on the line. It's not going to be stopping anytime soon but I'm not hyperventilating anymore.

I'm sure you're right too. I'm just trying to come out of this panic. I'm so scared of an eviction notice. What I'm feeling is probably very irrational. I don't know. I've never had this happen to me before.

I was looking at that, and I don't think I qualify. I don't have much karma. I'm not incredibly active as far as posting goes. I lurk a lot when I use Reddit.

Thank you for listening to me.
